Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this — we have an ongoing regulatory review and need Redwood's help to do two things for a specific Arborline tenant:

1) Preserve 90 days of inference/session logs (we understand default tenant TTL is 30 days) for a narrow time window (2026-03-01 to 2026-04-15) while our legal team completes a review.
2) After review completion, provide a deletion attestation package showing exported evidence for the preserved data and a proof-of-delete for the retained subset.

Can you confirm feasibility and an estimated timeline? Also include what artifacts Redwood can provide (export manifest, SHA hashes, Syslog snapshots, signed attestation). We may need this in under two weeks.

Attached: initial preservation matrix (arborline_preservation_manifest_v1.csv) with tenant ID and time ranges.

-Kelly

Adding technical detail for scheduling and constraints: 

- We can perform a targeted export of the tenant logs for the date range 2026-03-01 → 2026-04-15. Export options: compressed JSONL or parquet (parquet recommended for large volumes).
- Estimated data volume: ~38 GB compressed (based on average tenant traffic). Export job ETA: 6–8 hours to complete end-to-end in our Dedicated export pipeline.
- During the preservation window we'll flip the tenant's retention flag to 'preserve' which prevents automated GC for the specified objects. This is reversible only via an explicit operator action after your confirmation.
- Cost: one-time export pipeline credit of ~0.6 compute-credits (engineering estimate) and storage for preserved objects until deletion is executed. If you want a continuous mid-window export (e.g., produce a copy now), add 1–2 hours to schedule.

I will schedule the job once we have explicit scope confirmation + final tenant IDs from Arborline. We will place a temporary hold and surface the preservation object(s) on the Drive link listed in the related_links metadata.

-Ben

Kelly — all set and thanks for the clear acceptance. Short confirmation and deliverables list below.

Scope confirmation:
- Tenant: tenant_0009_arborline (ARB-CLIN-09)
- Range: 2026-03-01 → 2026-04-15 UTC

Actions we have taken / will take:
1) Preservation applied: we set a temporary preservation flag on the tenant's objects (prevents GC) as of 2026-05-26 12:15 PT.
2) Export scheduling: Ben to run the export job on 2026-05-28 08:00 PT. Expected job completion: 6–8 hours. Output format: parquet + manifest.
3) Artifact assembly (post-export):
   - Export manifest (list of object keys)
   - SHA256 checksums for each exported file
   - Operator deletion log (timestamped job IDs and operator id)
   - Signed deletion attestation (PDF) using deletion_cert_template.pdf
4) Access controls: preserved objects will be stored in a customer-dedicated bucket with tenant-scoped ACLs; no cross-tenant access permitted. We will include an explicit statement about isolation in the attestation.
5) Timeline: after export completes and you confirm proceed-with-delete, Redwood will execute deletion within 24 business hours and deliver the signed attestation within 3 business days.

Cost note: estimated one-time export compute charge ~0.6 compute-credits and storage for the preserved objects billed at standard retention rates. We will surface a final invoice line item prior to starting the export.

Please reply with explicit "Proceed with export and deletion workflow" acceptance and we will run the job on 2026-05-28 as scheduled. If you need a mid-window export delivered earlier, note that in your reply and we'll reprioritize.

Thanks — looping you to Priyom and Irene for attestation and legal language.
